recentItems.description:
In this episode of Yilungelo Lakho, we unpack intellectual property rights and what creatives need to know about protecting their work, understanding ownership and using other people’s work responsibly. We hear from creatives who have experienced challenges around ownership and infringement. Joining us in studio are experts explain how to protect your intellectual property and what recourse is available when your rights are violated.

recentItems.title: Asikhulume | Designing Cities That Work for the Youth
recentItems.description:
This week on Asikhulume /lets talk, we unpack how zoning laws, housing projects, and public transport infrastructure can unlock youth employment and business opportunities. Ngemuva kwamashumi amathathu eminyaka kusukela ngo-1994, umoya wobandlululo ngokwezindawo usabusa emadolobheni ethu. Millions of young South Africans remain stranded on the economic periphery, spending up to half their potential income just on minibus fares to look for work.
